_doc: Domain-randomized sim replay collection (docs/specs/S9_sim_dr_collect.md). Read by scripts/dr_collect.py, sim/dr_objects.py, sim/dr_render.py. URLs are the Isaac Sim 5.1 asset server; the container caches what it fetches.

physics_replay._extra_note: self-collision on, SDF colliders on every robot link (= physics_replay.py defaults since 2026-10-31): 10-14 closed loop 28/30 real successes lifted, 1/6 real misses lifted (docs/worklog/2026-10-31_sim_dr_pipeline.md)
physics_replay._phys_hz_note: 480 Hz since 2026-11-01: at 120 Hz the fingers go through the 1 mm cup wall in every tested replay (sim/penetration.py); 240 Hz in 2 of 5; 480 Hz in 0 of 5 (docs/worklog/2026-10-31_sim_dr_pipeline.md). ~4x slower.

cameras._lag_note: the real image lags the joint reading by ~0.75 frame (docs/worklog/2026-10-31_wrist_cup_offset.md section 6); 0 = render the pose of the same frame

render._brightness_note: auto exposure: every light is scaled until the front-left frame-0 mean grey lands on a target drawn from this range (real 10/14 front-left: p10/p50/p90 129/138/142; wrist 97/126/154). 2026-10-31 without it: 90-216, one studio variant 52% saturated | 2026-11-05: measured on a neutral mid-grey ground (a dark ground now stays dark); range raised 80-160 -> 100-170 because dark grounds pulled frames to ~60

objects._doc: geometry = physics-relevant variants (each one is validated by its own physics replay); appearance = visual only

bottle_appearance._doc: 2026-11-13 (EricC430 + Boyu, after D033): look of 'shape': 'bottle' objects in sim/dr_render.py instead of the cup kinds below. PET part clear or lightly tinted; cap always opaque; label sleeve with label_prob, otherwise a fully clear bottle (allowed on purpose). Empty bottles only (no liquid: the real ones are empty). The real 御茶園 590 ml has a full-wrap yellow label, clear shoulder, yellow cap (docs/worklog/2026-11-11_bottle_model.md); its label height was not measured. pet_material 'glass' = OmniGlass thin_walled on the closed PET surface, 'pbr_opacity' = OmniPBR with opacity (no refraction): which one looks right is 未確認 until rendered on the 4090. pet_ior 1.57 = typical PET (推論, not measured).

props._excluded: Mugs/SM_Mug_A2.usd, Mugs/SM_Mug_C1.usd: either one alone turns the whole frame black (2026-10-31, probably a NaN from its material)
props._note: studio: visual only, indoor-ish props. outdoor (2026-11-05, EricC: deployment is outdoors, no walls): vegetation, rocks, planters, path lights, bollards, fencing from the NVIDIA/Isaac asset library; same rules (ground, not collidable, outside keep-out radius). Occlusion of the object is not checked.

outdoor._excluded: Vegetation/Shrub/Hydrangea.usd: its Pine_bark.mdl is missing from the asset library (404, checked 2026-11-05); the other 26 assets' materials all resolve

environment._ground_note: EricC 2026-10-31: no table; the ground is the old table top (z=0), only the riser under the arm stays, relative heights unchanged; 2026-11-05 EricC: no 'room' mode (no walls), outdoor-heavy, campus ground types (sidewalk, asphalt, brick, concrete, grass, corridor stone/tile)
environment._ground_plain_note: 2026-11-05 EricC: plain-colour ground only in studio mode, earth tones (grey, beige, brown, dark green) with small jitter; outdoor always uses a material

ground_patterns._doc: procedural tiles from sim/dr_ground.py (EricC 2026-11-05: more sidewalk / asphalt / brick styles); on top of the Base MDL materials

environment._ground_excluded: Stone/Granite_Dark.mdl: reads as dark water with a sky reflection (2026-11-05 catalog)

lighting._colour_note: 2026-11-05: 2700-9500 K and jitter 0.15 tinted dark surfaces blue/orange (asphalt came out light blue-grey); daylight range now

bin._note: inside of the bin = a bag liner (the real bin has a green one, wrist camera 10-14); outside colour uniform random. Size and place come from the physics log (scene_constants.py BIN_*)
